label: LEAST_UPPER_BOUND_SUM1_1: Sum1 is the existing Mathlib IsLUB family u: every selected member is…
definition: Sum1 is the existing Mathlib IsLUB family u: every selected member is part of u and u is part of every upper bound. UnrestrictedSumOne requires such a u for every nonempty Lean Set. Least is stronger than merely minimal; Sum2 no-extra-parts is not included by definition.
note: Analyst framework for #1054, attribution deferred. Reuses the existing fixed partial-order domain and common-part Overlap without modal or actual-existence guards. Mathematical witnesses do not establish real-world parthood applicability. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
